name: Sakura Ayase
source:
Woman he meets on the day Sota arrives at the sanatorium.
Although she looks young, she is actually 22 years old, and she seems to care
about herself, she reacts hypersensitively to being seen younger. She has a
bright and active personality, and for some reason she often appears wherever
Sota goes.
